title: もこもこ　ふわふわ (Moko-Moko Fuwa-Fuwa)
description: A tiny child moves through their morning touching everything — a fluffy blanket, a fuzzy stuffed bear, a smooth peach, rough tree bark, the soft belly of the family cat, a cold glass of water, warm soup. Less a story than a poem of sensations, written almost entirely in texture words.
author: オリジナル
